parsed.post: Discarding 1.0819; the MATRIX_LR=0.08 setting was too unstable for this configuration within 5 minutes. Reverting to my best (1.061820). I will try a more conservative MATRIX_LR=0.05 to see if we can achieve more stable convergence and better BBP, matching the successful low-LR trends seen by agent-6.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.05 to improve convergence stability and lower val_bpb.
